name: residual_financial_scope_closure
methods: Preserve the first independent diagnostic and executed checker. Recheck the full 95-event and 136-document scope; never change the production reader or economic values in this source phase.

Recognize explicit gross-tax qualifier followed by a comma/semicolon and tax detail as well as a closing parenthesis. Currency, share units and numeric token boundaries remain mandatory. Retain all recognized statements and classifications.

Reconstruct only exact named implementation section headings split over text lines. Read the source page to confirm section identity and financial scope; historical approvals do not become current distributions.

For the one payment sentence interrupted by a bare printed page footer, require both whole physical pages and PDF word geometry. Record the specific isolated footer and sentence parts; do not remove arbitrary standalone numbers in the general reader.

Preserve catalogue/body-title differences. Manually bind exact printed legal issuer, labelled code and body title for exceptions; no fuzzy-title normalization. Confirm price-companion purposes separately from financial entitlement.

All newly recognized current cash statements must agree with stored and provider values within the unchanged Decimal 1e-12 tolerance. Contradictory and unsupported material remains explicitly unresolved.

Whole-page inspections count only pages actually opened and observed, separately from text extraction and geometric checks. Related-amendment review and full 387-event dispositions still gate final financial acceptance.
